ui.hero.title: One platform for every animal in your care
ui.hero.sub: Records, daily operations and teamwork across all your locations. Find any task in Antz, with the actual screens.
ui.modules.lede: Click on any card to open its guide, with all its features and screens.
ui.cta.text: Each module has its features and actual screens in this guide. Continue from where you stopped, or write to us and we will help you.
ui.day.title: What your first day on Antz looks like
ui.day.2: Get to know how to navigate
ui.day.4: Give every person the appropriate access permissions
ui.day.4.desc: Create roles that match the structure of your organization and enable permissions module by module, so that each person sees what their work needs.
ui.faq.q2: Does it work on phones and computers?
ui.faq.a2: Yes. The phone app covers field work, such as notes, treatments, transfers and egg records. The web app covers office work, such as the hospital system, incubator setup, reports and pharmacy stock. Updates appear instantly on the phone, tablet and desktop computer.
ui.faq.q3: Can we control who sees what?
ui.faq.a3: Yes. Access is based on roles. You create the roles your organization uses, such as "zoologist", and enable permissions module by module.
ui.faq.q4: We manage more than one location. Does that suit us?
ui.faq.a4: Antz keeps the data of all locations and departments in one place. Housing is organized by location, department and enclosure, and transfers between locations go through approval and a security check-out.
ui.faq.a5: Start with the "Getting Started" guide, then open the modules your role uses. If something is unclear, write to us at hello@antz.systems.

m.necropsy.title: Post-mortem dissection
m.necropsy.intro: The dissection module documents post-mortem examinations with detailed notes, organ-specific findings and medical conclusions. It supports accurate analysis of the cause of death, standardizes reporting, ensures carcasses are handled in a timely manner, and meets legal, audit and veterinary standards.
m.necropsy.f1.title: Search and filtering
m.necropsy.f1.desc: Search by animal/species; and filter by location, date or priority.
m.necropsy.f2.title: Status tracking
m.necropsy.f2.desc: Monitor the stages of transfer: incoming, pending, draft, completed. [?]
m.necropsy.f3.title: Animal card and request information
m.necropsy.f3.desc: AID number, species, location, reason, requester, and priority.
m.deworming.title: Getting rid of worms
m.deworming.intro: The getting-rid-of-worms module supports systematic recording and follow-up of anti-parasite treatments, ensuring administration at the right time, proper documentation and clear tracking of every activity of getting rid of worms for every animal.
m.deworming.f1.title: Views by status
m.deworming.f1.desc: Worm-removal treatments classified into upcoming, pending, skipped and completed for ease of follow-up.
m.deworming.f2.title: Managing getting rid of worms
m.deworming.f2.desc: Schedule a course of treatment or directly record a medicine that was given, specifying the dates and details.
m.deworming.f3.title: Recording administration
m.deworming.f3.desc: Records the dose, batch number, method of administration, notes and optional follow-up.
m.housing.title: Housing
m.housing.intro: The housing module organizes animal habitats across your locations, departments and enclosures, so that every animal has a known place and every change is tracked. Access at each level depends on permissions.
m.housing.f1.title: Managing locations
m.housing.f1.desc: Add or edit locations with role-based permissions for safe and organized access.
m.housing.f2.title: Managing departments
m.housing.f2.desc: Add or edit departments within the zoo, with permission-based controls for safe management.
m.housing.f3.title: Managing enclosures
m.housing.f3.desc: Add or edit enclosures and monitor each one for effective oversight of animals and data.
m.fetal-death.title: Death of fetuses
m.fetal-death.intro: The fetal-death module records and manages incidents of fetal death within enclosures, documenting the cause, timing and details of the animals involved. It supports veterinary care, monitoring of reproductive health, trend analysis, and improving the management of animal populations.
m.fetal-death.f1.title: Adding a fetus death record
m.fetal-death.f1.desc: Record new incidents: the cause, timing, the parents and animal information.
m.fetal-death.f2.title: Search and filtering
m.fetal-death.f2.desc: Search by keyword; and filter by location, date, stillbirth, miscarriage, species or sex.
m.fetal-death.f3.title: Viewing death records
m.fetal-death.f3.desc: Full details, number of days since death, cause, identifier, enclosure, location, and sex.
m.egg-management-app.title: Egg management — App
m.egg-management-app.intro: The egg module tracks the complete life cycle of eggs, from laying to hatching or transfer to the incubator, ensuring accurate records, instant updates and complete traceability for better coordination and accountability among the nest, incubator and hatchery teams.
m.egg-management-app.f1.title: Egg dashboard
m.egg-management-app.f1.desc: Live counts: in nests, transferred to the incubator, and designated for culling.
m.egg-management-app.f2.title: Entering eggs (nest / incubator)
m.egg-management-app.f2.desc: Add eggs with parents, condition, dates, species, notes and attachments.
m.egg-management-app.f3.title: Life cycle tracking
m.egg-management-app.f3.desc: Status, weight and the full timeline of the egg's journey.
m.administer-medicine.title: Giving medicines
m.administer-medicine.intro: The administration module complements medical records by turning medical prescriptions into executable treatment workflows, making it possible to deliver care instantly to individual animals or groups, in the field or in the hospital.
m.administer-medicine.f1.title: Quick entry
m.administer-medicine.f1.desc: Create a direct administration record for a specific date without writing a full medical record.
m.administer-medicine.f2.title: Search and filtering
m.administer-medicine.f2.desc: Find records quickly and narrow the list by date, entity, species or controlled substance. [?]
m.administer-medicine.f3.title: Status tracking
m.administer-medicine.f3.desc: View treatments by date across four tabs: pending, administered, skipped, stopped.
m.vaccination.title: Vaccination
m.vaccination.intro: The vaccination module manages the complete vaccination cycle for animals, from scheduling and direct administration to tracking upcoming, pending, skipped and completed vaccinations. It ensures treatment at the right time, accurate dose recording, and complete traceability for disease prevention and clinical compliance.
m.vaccination.f1.title: Views by status
m.vaccination.f1.desc: Vaccinations classified into upcoming, pending, skipped and completed for ease of follow-up.
m.vaccination.f2.title: Managing vaccination
m.vaccination.f2.desc: Schedule a vaccination or directly record a vaccine that was given, specifying the dates and medicine details.
m.vaccination.f3.title: Recording administration
m.vaccination.f3.desc: Records the dose, batch number, method of administration, notes and optional follow-up.
m.pharmacy-web.title: Pharmacy (Web)
m.pharmacy-web.intro: Enables the dispensing of medical products quickly, accurately and traceably directly to authorized doctors, ensuring timely fulfillment and automatic stock updating from the prescription to the shelf, with batch-level visibility and tracking of expiry dates throughout.
m.pharmacy-web.f1.title: Dashboard
m.pharmacy-web.f1.desc: Instant insights into stock issues, shipments, purchases, orders, consumption, expiry and fast-moving products, with visual trends for quick action.
m.pharmacy-web.f2.title: Smart search and filtering
m.pharmacy-web.f2.desc: Quickly find records by order identifier, doctor's name or pharmacy.
m.pharmacy-web.f3.title: Master data (stands and shelves)
m.pharmacy-web.f3.desc: Organize storage by numbers of stands/shelves for ease of access and updating, with customizable data (packaging, unit of measure, salts, engines, manufacturers). [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f4.title: Managing stock reports
m.pharmacy-web.f4.desc: Stock by batch with value and expiry date; flagging low-stock/expired items; monitoring approaching expiries; and managing the guarantee/escrow with dispute resolution. [?]
m.pharmacy-web.f5.title: Managing products and stock
m.pharmacy-web.f5.desc: Create products, track stock and expiry dates, record purchases/consignments, keep a unified ledger, and handle substitutes/variants.
m.pharmacy-web.f6.title: Managing dispensing
m.pharmacy-web.f6.desc: Doctors can prescribe and dispense medicines, or receive them directly from the pharmacy, with everything recorded.
m.pharmacy-web.f7.title: Managing shipments
m.pharmacy-web.f7.desc: Track incoming and outgoing medicine shipments and carry them out within the app.
m.pharmacy-web.f8.title: Stock adjustment and reports
m.pharmacy-web.f8.desc: Record stock changes (missing, damaged, expired); keep the audit log; manage returns to suppliers; and download reports on consumption, returns, purchases and dispensing for finance and demand estimation purposes.
m.getting-started.title: Getting started
m.getting-started.intro: The "Getting Started" guide introduces the purpose of the app, and guides new users through the basic steps of setting up their personal profile, exploring the main features, and navigating the platform effectively.
m.getting-started.f1.title: Access and workspaces
m.getting-started.f1.desc: Log in securely and enter the work environment assigned to you.
m.getting-started.f2.title: Navigation and interface
m.getting-started.f2.desc: Use the home page to see updates, quick navigation shortcuts, and the bottom panel for essential tools.
m.getting-started.f3.title: Dissection / administration / pending allocation [?]
m.getting-started.f3.desc: Animals awaiting dissection, administrative documentation, and subsequent allocation or disposal procedures before the final closing of records.
m.getting-started.f4.title: Master setup and modules
m.getting-started.f4.desc: Set up the master data, and explore modules such as medical records, housing, eggs, diet and animal management.
m.getting-started.f5.title: Personal customization
m.getting-started.f5.desc: Manage your notes, update your profile, and set your language preferences.
m.getting-started.f6.title: Permissions
m.getting-started.f6.desc: Learn about the access levels required for safe operations.
